whoWereThey.name: Isaac Newton
whoWereThey.bio: Mathematician and physicist who formulated the laws of motion and universal gravitation. Founder of calculus.

whoWereThey.name: Rosalind Franklin
whoWereThey.bio: Chemist and X-ray crystallographer. Her work was central to understanding the molecular structure of DNA.
